modules.module_title: Prepare for welding and cutting operations

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done and product specifications by interpreting the product drawing, and instructions received from MMAW welder
identify and arrange the tools, welding machines, cutting torches, measuring instruments, accessories, consumables and input materials (i.e. carbon, low alloy steel etc.) as per the requirements
check the input material, tools and equipment for any defects before use
prepare the work area for the welding and cutting activities
prepare the materials and joint for welding and cutting process
support the MMAW welder in setting of the MMAW/gas cutting machine and its parameters as per the WPS and SOP
install the work pieces and fixture on the apparatus and align them with the electrodes as per the job requirements
follow safety precautions during welding and cutting work as per SOP and organizational guidelines
start the MMAW machine for welding operations
support the MMAW welder in performing MMAW welding process as per SOP
support the MMAW welder in producing different joints in all welding positions as specified in WPS
provide appropriate consumables and accessories to welder during welding process
monitor the welding process parameters (air pressure, electrode force, electrode distance, gas flow etc.) are within standards by reading the various gauges and correct them if not within standards
measure the final welded piece and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing
remove extra material, slag etc. by using brush, chipping hammers, grinders etc., from the welded piece
hammer the work piece to get the desired shape, if there are any welding bulges/distortions
start the gas cutting machine for cutting operations
support the MMAW welder in performing gas cutting process as per SOP
support the MMAW welder in producing thermal cuts in various forms of material which meet specified quality criteria and specifications as specified in WPS
provide appropriate consumables and accessories to welder during cutting process
measure the final workpiece and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing

modules.module_title: Support in post-welding and cutting operations

pcs.pc_description: shut down the equipment and remove the workpiece after completion of welding and cutting activities
support the MMAW welder in checking the work pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
assist in conducting visual inspection, destructive and non-destructive tests on the work pieces
separate the defective pieces which can be repaired/ reworked and pieces which are beyond repair
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
